**Structured Notes**

| Field Name | Description |
|---|---|
| Structure Notes | Indicates whether the instrument belongs to structure notes |
| Issuer Name | Indicates the issuer name (if any) even without an issuer customer record |
| Option Strategy | Indicates the option strategy linked to the structured product. This attribute is applicable to all variants. |
| Underlying | Indicates the link to the SECURITY.MASTER ID, which is the underlying for the note |
| Other Underlying | Indicates the other underlying (apart from the security) such as the currency, commodity, index, currency ID, DX.CONTRACT.MASTER ID or any free format definition for the underlying. For other underlying, the system does not track spot price changes (such as comparison with strike, stop loss and knock-out prices and the like) for generating status reports. |
| Underlying Description | Indicates the short name from SECURITY.MASTER (underlying securities or free format description) |
| Market Identifier | Indicates the market identifier. If the underlying is the SECURITY.MASTER ID, the market identifier is ISIN. |
| Spot Price | Indicates the spot price of the underlying. This is provided by the issuer and is not automatically updated based on the Last Price in SECURITY.MASTER . |
| Weight | Indicates the weight of each underlying. If a single underlying is linked to a note, the weight is assumed as 100%. In case of multiple underlying instruments (basket), this weight is of each underlying. The total weight should be 100%. |
| Price Barrier Type | Indicates the record ID from SC.NOTE.PRICE.TYPE to denote whether the price is issue price, strike price, barrier, knock-out, bonus level, coupon strike level, or airbag level. As the records are user-defined, any type of price or barrier information can be recorded. |
| Price Percentage | Indicates the price percentage for the automatic update of the price or barrier level based on the spot price (provided there is a single underlying). |
| Note Price Barrier | Indicates the issue, strike price or barrier as specified above, which is manually or auto calculated. |
| Reset Date | Indicates the date on which barrier levels is reset (for example, stop-loss price for mini-futures is reset by the calculation agent). This is generally the last day of the month. If the last day is not a working day, then the next business day is considered. The values in this field depend on the value in the Reset Frequency field. Any changes to the stop-loss price is communicated to the customer. |
| Reset Frequency | Indicates the frequency of reset date rollover |
| Pr Trigger | Indicates the onset of the trigger |
| Pr Trigger Date | Indicates the date on which the event is triggered |
| Worst Of | Indicates whether worst-of feature is applicable for these multiple underlying instruments. |
| Investment Date | Indicates the date from which the note is available for investment (earliest). If this date is not specified, issue date is considered. Any transactions involving the note prior to this date results in a system override. |
| Fixing Date | Indicates the date (number of days prior to maturity) when the fixing is done to determine the payout. Any payout processed before this date results in a system override. |
| Digital | Indicates if this instrument is a digital variant of principal protected product. |
| All In Cost | Indicates the percentage of the investment amount, which is the all-in-cost applicable to the product. This covers the financing cost, issuance cost and so on. |
| All In Cost Basis | Indicates whether the all in cost is part of the issue price. The values are: Inclusive - All in cost is a part of the issue price. The system calculates and stores it at the trade level for information purpose only. Exclusive - All in cost is not a part of the issue price. It is calculated and posted in Cu Misc Fees field of the trade to be posted. |
| All In Cost Issuer | Indicates whether the all in cost is calculated for the issuer (broker or counterparty) side of the trade and posted in Br Misc Fees field. |
| Price Tracker | Indicates how the spot price of the underlying is monitored against the barrier levels. If this field is set to MATURITY, the knock-out or barrier comparison is done at maturity. If it is set to CONTINUING, the knock-out or barrier is tracked throughout the life cycle. |
| Leverage | Indicates the leverage applicable for products. For example, the values 1 to 4X denotes the leverage applicable for products like mini futures. |
| Effective Leverage | Indicates the effective leverage which is auto-calculated based on the values in the Spot Price and Issue Price fields (Spot/Issue = nX) |
| Capital Protection | Indicates the percentage of the protected capital |
| Participation Level | Indicates the participation level on the upside over strike |
| Downside Participation | Indicates whether the investor receives the invested amount and the percentage in the downside movement of the underlying. This is applicable for a product like twin-win certificate. |
| Cap | Identifies the percentage above strike, which is used to cap the maximum returns. |
| Rebate | Indicates the percentage above strike received by the investor. This is applicable only with a knock-out feature (on principal protected products). |
| Cpn Observe Dt | Indicates the capital protection notes with coupon to specify the dates on which, the coupon is observed to check for cap or floor levels. |
| Cpn Observe Fqu | Indicates whether the coupon observation date is auto rolled over. If the date happens to be a holiday, the rollover is to the next business day. |
| Cpn Cap | Identifies the cap rate of coupon applicable for capital protection notes with coupon |
| Cpn Floor | Identifies the floor rate of coupon for capital protection notes |
| Cpn Range Start | Indicates the start of the range for range accrual notes product (for example, if the Euro Interbank Offer Rate (Euribor) is in the range of 2 to 3% on all days, then coupon rate is 5% for which, this field is set as two). |
| Cpn Range End | Indicates the end of the range for range accrual notes product (for example, if the Euribor is in the range of 2 to 3% on all days, then coupon rate is 5% for which, this field is set as 3) |
| Coupon Reference | Indicates the reference for annual coupon (for example, 3 month Euribor) |
| Memory | Indicates whether a memory feature is applicable for memory notes |
| Pay Out Formula | Indicates whether the payout amount is calculated manually or based on routine indicated in the Pay out Routine field (at either SM level or sub asset type level). For products like mini futures, a formula can be specified, which is a term sheet element but not used for any calculation. |
| Pay Out Routine | The routine to calculate the payout details and update SC.NOTE.PAYOUT |
| Credit Event | Indicates the credit event. |
| Cr Event Triggered | Indicates whether the credit event occurred or not |
| Cr Trigger Date | Indicates the date of the credit event |
| Cr Recovery Rate | Indicates the percentage of the initial investment received by the investor, in case of principal default credit event. |

**Structured Notes**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Pr Trigger | Indicates if there is a breach of the associated price barrier. This field is display-only. The values are YES and NO. |
| Pr Trigger Date | Indicates the date of the price barrier breach |
| Cr Even Triggered | Indicates the occurrence of the credit event specified in the Credit Event field |
| Cr Trigger Date | Indicates the date on which on which the credit event has occurred |
| Price Barrier Type | Indicates a valid record in SC.NOTE.PRICE.BARRIER.TYPE . The price barriers could be KNOCK OUT, STOP LOSS, BONUS LEVEL and so on. |

**Structured Notes**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Description | Indicates the description of the structured note instrument. This field defaults from SECURITY.MASTER . This is a display-only field. |
| Diary Type | Indicates a valid record in the DIARY.TYPE record |
| Issue price | Indicates the issue price of the structured note. The value in this field defaults from the Issue Price field in SECURITY.MASTER . This is a display-only field. |
| Strike Price | Indicates the strike price for the underlying equity. The value in this field defaults from the Strike Price field in SECURITY.MASTER . This is a display-only field. |
| Underlying | Indicates the underlying for the note defaulted from SECURITY.MASTER . This is a display-only field. |
| Maturity Price | Indicates the rice of the associated underlying at the time of pay-out. The value in this field defaults from the Last Price field in SECURITY.MASTER . This is a display-only field. |
| Cap Protection | Indicates the percentage of the capital. The value in this field defaults from the Last Price field in SECURITY.MASTER . This is a display-only field. |
| Cap | Indicates the percentage above strike used to cap the maximum returns. The value in this field defaults from the Cap field in SECURITY.MASTER . This is a display-only field. |
| Participation Level | Indicates the participation level on the upside over strike. The value in this field defaults from the Participation Level field in SECURITY.MASTER . This is a display-only field. |
| Knock Out Barrier | Indicates if the knock out barrier is allowed or not |
| Rebate | Indicates he percentage above strike that the investor receives for knock-out. The value in this field defaults from the Rebate field in SECURITY.MASTER . This is a display-only field. |
| Coupon Rate | Indicates the rate at which the coupon is payed out. This field is mandatory for the COUPON event and is mapped to the Rate field in DIARY application. |
| Payout Price | Indicates the price at which the note is redeemed. If a pay out routine is defined for this instrument or Sub Asset Type , the value is either defaulted based on the routine logic or manually updated. This field is mandatory for the REDEMPTION event and is mapped to the Rate field in DIARY application. |
| Payout Underlying Price | Indicates the price at which the underlying is paid out. This field is mandatory for the CONVERSION event and is mapped to the New Price field in DIARY application. |
| Underlying Old Ratio | Indicates the ratio to covert the note to the underlying stock. This field is mandatory for the CONVERSION event and is mapped to the Old Ratio field in DIARY application. |
| Underlying New Ratio | Indicates the ratio to covert the note to the underlying stock. This field is mandatory for the CONVERSION event and is mapped to the New Ratio field in DIARY application. |

**Trade Creation**

| ID component | Description |
|---|---|
| SCTRSC | Identifies the transaction as a SEC.TRADE |
| yy | Indicates the year that the transaction is being entered, that is, 04 indicates year 2004 |
| ddd | Indicates the Julian day that the transaction is being entered, that is, the number of days since the beginning of the year, so 2, January is represented as 002. |
| nnnnn | Indicates the transaction sequence number |

**Trade Creation**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Customer No | Allows only those customers setup as customers in the CUSTOMER.SECURITY application |
| Cust Trans Code | Helps the user to tell Temenos Transact if the customer is buying or selling the security, by entering the particular SC.TRANS.NAME applicable to buy or sell. If the user is not sure of the value, he can drill down to the SC.TRANS.NAME application to obtain the required transaction code. Then, the customer’s portfolio is updated. Temenos Transact always defaults to the first portfolio belonging to the customer. For example, a customer (1250) owning 1250-1 and 1250-75 portfolios always has the securities defaulted to portfolio 1250-1. If the user requires the securities held in or withdrawn from the other portfolio, it must be entered manually always. |
| Cu Account No | Specifies the identification of the customer’s financial account to be used to either obtain or pay the funds required. This field can be the subject of a very elaborate defaulting process (Read Portfolio Valuation for more information). The defaults are already setup and the user has to enter the key to view them if the user prefers to enter an alternative account that does not belong to that customer. For example , a customer is allowed to pay for securities using any preferred currency, so that the user can enter any financial account if it is pre-defined in the SEC.ACC.MASTER application. Temenos Transact uses the current forex rates to arrive at the amount of currency required but the user is able to type in own specified conversion rate, if required. The definition of an account not belonging to the portfolio customer causes an override during the opening or changing of a portfolio record. Also, when a particular transaction is designated to use another customer's account, any occurrence of that transaction also raises an override. |
| Cust Nominal | Indicates the number of share-type or quantity of nominal bond-type security the customer is buying or selling. Once the user enters the amount in this field, it is immediately validated to ensure that it complies with the trading units recorded in the underlying SECURITY.MASTER application’s Trading Units field. Therefore, the user must ensure that this amount is divisible by the trading unit and that it is equal to or greater than the trading unit. In case of unit trust and fund type securities, which can be traded in fractions, the Trading Units field must be set to zero to enable the user to process these particular types. |
| Cust Price | Specifies the the buy or sell price, that is, the price at which the trade is transacted. However there may be instances, especially when entering a large number of customer transactions (as in a bulk SEC.TRADE ) when the user may utilise a price defaulting procedure. |
| Customer Total Nominal, Cu Gross Am Sec, Customer Gross Amount | Indicates the total number of the security and the value of the transaction (before addition of other items such as tax, charges and interest) in both security and trade (settlement) currency. As the user progresses through the transaction and if the user validates the record, Temenos Transact automatically calculates various information. For example, post input of the price relative to the trade, the next three fields Customer Total Nominal, Cu Gross Am Sec, Customer Gross Amount Trade are populated depending upon the amount of the security traded and the price . As both the nominal and price fields are sub-values, the user can enter tranches of purchases or sales for the same customer portfolio. |

**Trade Creation**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Broker No | Identifies the broker with whom the organisation is arranging the security purchase or sale. The user can enter the basic customer mnemonic appertaining to the broker (if the user is aware of it). Then Temenos Transact performs an immediate validation to check if the chosen ID is a broker or counterpart. If not, the entered value is rejected by the validation process. |
| Broker Type | Confirms whether the role of the broker is entered in the Broker No field and is defaulted from the relevant record in CUSTOMER.SECURITY . This defaulting occurs ony when the underlying broker is setup to perform a single role. In those cases, where the broker may act in more than a single capacity, the user must inform the Temenos Transact about the precise role. |
| Broker Transaction Code | Specifies if the broker is buying or selling the security. As with the customer side of the SEC.TRADE , the user must enter into the Broker Transaction Code field, the required purchase or sale transaction from SC.TRANS.NAME . |
| Broker Acc No | Indicates the delivery details with regard to both the cash and security components of the transaction. It specifies the organisation’s Nostro over which the financial entries are to be posted. If required, payment can be effected over a Vostro account also. To affect a default, the user has to ensure that there is an existing record for the settlement currency on the NOSTRO.ACCOUNT application to be used by the Security application. If this is not the case, the user must enter any valid Nostro or Vostro account in the system, provided that the currency is similar to the settlement currency. For defaulting the broker account number from CUSTOMER.SECURITY application to the Broker Acc No field in the SEC.TRADE application, the system checks if the Br Sett Internal field is set to Yes. If this field is set to Yes, then the system defaults the cash or internal account (based on category) from the Br Set Acc field. If the system is unable to default an account in trade currency from Br Set Acc field, then the system displays the ‘Settlement account not found’ error. The user can manually enter the broker account or can update the record in CUSTOMER.SECURITY and re-input the transaction. |
| Broker Depo | Specifies the depository that the broker is using. The settlement method used decides whether this is a mandatory field or not. For example, if the user prefers to effect the settlement through Euroclear, the system must be able to build a valid formatted message type. Temenos Transact requires this information and displays a message, if this field is left blank. If it is not required, the user can leave the field blank. Although, Temenos Transact does not object, if the user prefers to specify the broker depository for the sake of valid information. If the user has to enter information in this field, for example, if Euroclear is used a valid depository must be entered. |
| Depository | This field in SEC.TRADE tells Temenos Transact a valid depository as defined in the CUSTOMER.SECURITY application where the organisation is to receive or deliver securities. The user can enter any valid record in CUSTOMER specifying the depository, which the broker is using. If the broker depository does not exist in the CUSTOMER application, the user can put the SEC.TRADE on hold and create a record in CUSTOMER. However, if the depository is barely used, the user may not prefer to open a record in CUSTOMER . So, in these instances Temenos Transact allows to type the depository name and address details using free format characters as required. |
| Broker Security Depository Account | Allows the broker account number by which it is identified at that same depository. This may default if the broker is using either Euroclear, Cedel, BNB or SEGA settlement systems and the broker’s account number is defined in the relative record in CUSTOMER.SECURITY . If the user is not using any of these particular depositories, enter any value to identify the broker’s account at the depot specified. |
| Broker Number Nominal | Specifies the amount of the security being purchased from or sold to the broker. This amount must comprise the total of the customer side of the transaction. This applies unless the user has arranged to accommodate the customer requirements using more than a single broker. In this case, the user must expand the fields and enter the second broker details in the same way as the first broker. On input, Temenos Transact validates the total from both sides of the transaction net out. |
| Broker Price | Specifies the price arranged with the broker. If the user wants to expand both the Broker Number Nominal and Broker Price fields, he can arrange the transaction in several tranches using different prices. |
| Broker Total Nominal, Broker Gross Amount Security and Broker Gross Amount Trade | Displays the total amount of the security arranged with the broker, the gross value of the security in security currency and the gross amount in the trade currency whether or not the transaction is for settlement in a different currency or not. The values in these fields are calculated based on the sum of the Broker Number Nominal multi-value fields for each broker. |
| Br Reallowance | Works exactly the same way as the identical two fields on the customer side of the transaction. If the user purchases securities through the broker on behalf of a customer, the entry of an amount reduces the overall amount the user has to pay to the broker. Therefore, if the user wants to add a re-allowance for a purchase, the user can use the leading - (minus) sign. If the user has arranged a sale to the broker, entry of an amount causes to be added to the overall proceeds. Therefore, the user should add a leading minus, if he prefers to reduce the overall precedes, which the organisation is to receive. |
| Broker Gross Accrued | Includes the consideration and any interest, if applicable. The Broker Gross Accrued field is a no-input system generated field, which illustrates the basic amount of the transaction and any interest (if applicable). Re-verify this field to ascertain that the trade proceeds prior to the addition or subtraction of any commissions, taxes, charges and other ad hoc amounts that affects the overall transaction proceeds |
| Broker Gross Amount Trade | Indicates the total contract value that includes any re-allowance. The user must be able to ascertain the effect of the chosen input into the re-allowance field. Until the user is used to this process, compare the value of the Broker Gross Accrued field to the value in the Broker Gross Amount Trade field. |
| Broker Interest Amount | Includes the Temenos Transact calculated interest amount relative to the nominal amount dealt with the broker, if the underlying security is an interest-bearing instrument. |
| Broker Fees Miscellaneous | Facilitates the user to prompt the system to add the interest if applicable by using the ENTER key. The process enables Temenos Transact to default the commission, foreign fees, stamp tax and if applicable, the Effectenboursenverein (EBV) related fees fields allowing the user to supply any ad hoc fees. The EBV fees are defaulted from the SC.BROK.STK.EXCH.FEES application. The user is free to move back to any field and either type in a different amount altogether or use the ENTER key over the field to remove the value. |
| Broker Commission | Indicates any commission relative to the trade. This is based on the rules contained within the relative STOCK.EXCHANGE application as defined in the Stock Exchange field in the beginning of the transaction. This in turn provides a link to one of the stock exchange calculation countries. For example, if the transaction is resolved through the Luxembourg Exchange, the STK.EXC.LU application contains the various commission rates. The user can overtype this amount with an entirely different amount, including zero, if necessary. |
| Broker Foreign Fee | Works similar to the Broker Commission field in which the user may overtype any fee defaulted by the system as set up on the underlying STOCK.EXCHANGE application. |
| Cl Commission | Enables the user to enter the required amount, if the user wants to enter a charge or commission amount in the event of updating a transaction on behalf of a customer only. Input is allowed only when the transaction includes a customer and is inhibited when the user is completing the current multi-value fields in respect of a broker or counterpart. |
| Broker Stamp Tax | This field value depends on is the value set up in the underlying STOCK.EXCHANGE application as with the Broker Commission and Broker Foreign Fee fields. The user may overtype whatever value is defaulted, if the user wants to change it. |
| Broker EBV Fees | This is a special field intended for those Temenos Transact users in Switzerland. However, the contents depend upon the rules as laid down in the STK.EXCH.LOCAL application relative to the organisation. As with the customer side of the transaction, the Broker Fees Miscellaneous field is added to accommodate those instances when the user may encounter any miscellaneous ad hoc fees that cannot be readily set up in the STOCK.EXCHANGE application . If the user has defined in SC.STD.SEC.TRADE for demarcating and allocation of the treasury profit to the originating branch, the user is required to input the treasury price in the SEC.TRADE , which is again optional. In the absence of which, the system posts the difference between the Broker Price and Cust Price to the Market Pl Cat stated therein in SC.STD.SEC.TRADE application. Upon input, the difference between the treasury price and broker price is posted to the respective market P/L category defined in SC.STD.SEC.TRADE application. Any difference between the treasury price and customer price is posted to the respective treasury P/L category as defined in the SC.STD.SEC.TRADE application. |
| Broker Net Amount Trade | Displays the net contract value for the broker in the trade currency. This amount is made up of all components (commissions, taxes and so on) in respect of the broker and represents the amount to be paid or received from that broker. |
| Broker Account Currency | Calculates the contents of the settlement amount in the Broker Account Currency field. The previous Broker Account Currency field BR.ACCOUNT.CCY confirms only the currency of the brokers’ cash account over which they have requested settlement defined by the user or by default in the Broker Acc No field. Unlike customers who can pay for their securities using any currency they wish, Temenos Transact does not allow the broker to be paid in any currency other than the security currency. |
| Broker Deliver Instruction | This field value must comprise a valid SC.DEL.INSTR application component, but defaulting can occur or the user can enter a valid choice of his own. This field is similar to the Customer Delivery Instruction field except the broker requirement specified. The user is not able to affect a delivery against payment instruction if the user and broker depot differ. The values entered here also affect the Temenos Transact SEC.DEL.CONTROL application, which expects only the security movements, if the transaction is free of payment but both cash and securities are dealt on an against payment basis. The various validation rules are obtained using the rules specified in each SC.DEL.INSTR application. These instructions form a part of the message formats when building SWIFT type messages for use when settling through Euroclear, Cedel and other automated settlement facilities. |
| Advice Default | The Advice Default field in the SC.PARAMETER application controls the default for all other YES or NO fields in the application. If the user prefers to suppress instructions or advice to the customers, brokers, depositories or any combinations thereof, they can do so by populating the YES or NO fields, as shown in the below screenshot. |
| Broker Beneficiary Bank | This field displays the beneficiary bank which is to be used for the payment or receipt of the Broker amount due. This applies only when the broker does not maintain account facilities at the organisation. If there is no default, this is obtained from the AGENCY application, and the user can enter a valid customer to identify the beneficiary bank. If this is not set up in the customer database, the user has a choice of putting the transaction on hold and creating the required record and relating the AGENCY details or the user may prefer to type the bank name and address instead. |
| Broker Beneficiary 2 | This field helps the user to enter a valid customer ID to identify the second bank in situations when the user must utilise a second beneficiary bank in order to properly effect the required payment to the broker. |
| Broker Beneficiary Address | This field helps the user who is preparing a settlement to a lesser used bank and does not want to set up CUSTOMER and AGENCY records to enter the details into a set of multi-value fields. Here, the user must enter both name and full address of the respective bank. These fields are complex as there are in-built controls designed to protect the user from erroneous input. Wherever possible, users are advised to ensure that the database includes all the banks that they are likely to encounter along with the relevant AGENCY details, thereby ensuring that Temenos Transact can help to eliminate the need to enter repetitive settlement details. Another way to ensure that broker settlement details are defaulted correctly in SEC.TRADE is to set up the SC.SETT.INSTRUCT application to record the Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI) of the broker. Then, the system automatically defaults the various fields pertaining to the broker. |

**Trade Creation**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| To Contra Ref | Specifies whether the trade entered is contra to an existing transaction and the transaction reference of the original trade. |
| Contra By Ref | Specifies the transaction reference of the contra trade on the original transaction. |
| Exch Rate Sec | In a contra transaction, this is an input field and the user can amend the default rate to a rate applicable to the original transaction. |

**Trade Creation**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Stamp Indicator | Defaults from SC.SETT.INSTRUCT based on the transaction code of broker, but can be manually overridden. The value must be in AAAA/BBBB or BBBB format. The value is mapped to 22F Tag and the Stamp Duty indicator in sequence E of MT54X(X = 0 to 3). This is a free format field and validation is not done. |
| Sparty Narr Qual | Qualifier pertaining to narrative in 70a Tag of SETPRTY block in MT540 to MT543. |
| Sprty Narrative | This free format narrative is mapped to 70a Tag of SETPRTY block in MT540 to MT543. If narrative is entered with DECL qualifier, it is mapped to 70E Tag in SETPRTY block. If narrative is entered with PART or REGI qualifier, it is mapped to 70D Tag in SETPRTY block. If narrative is entered with PACO qualifier, it is mapped to 70C Tag in SETPRTY block. |
| Bene Owner | The user can enter a beneficial owner and this is mapped to 22F Tag qualifier BENE in SETDET block. The value must be entered as per SWIFT guidelines. |
| Buyr Nation | The user can enter a valid country code of the buyer and this is mapped to 95C tag in the qualifier INVE of OTHRPRTY block. |

**Trade Creation**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Cu Wht Perc | Signifies the tax rate applicable as defaulted from the tax rate in the TAX application. The tax rate in the Cu Wht Perc field defaults from the TAX.TYPE.CONDITION application. |
| Customer Withhold Tax | Indicates the amount after computing the tax value based on the tax rate in the Cu Wht Perc field and the amount. The net amount trade is computed after deducting the WHT, if any. |
| Wht Tax Code | The Wht Tax Code defaults from the Share Tax or Bond Tax field from TXN.TAX.CODE , if the security code is share or bond, respectively. |
| Cu Wht Perc, Cu Wht Tax and Wht Tax Code | The fields in ORDER.BY.CUST, SEC.OPEN.ORDER, SC.EXE.SEC.ORDERS and SEC.TRADE indicate the amount of taxation in trade currency. A linked tax is applied on this amount. |
| Cu Net Am Trd | The deduction amount is included in the amount defined in this field in each of these applications. |
| Cu Gross Am Trd or Cu Gross Accr | The value is used as the base amount depending on the accrued interest. This is indicated in the Amt Base field in TXN.TAX.CODE . |

| 6 | Restriction | If the IS is R-CCYGT30, the restrictions are applied to all security holdings that has an individual currency holding more than 30%. | R-CCYGT30 |

**TransactionFees Charges Taxes**

| Security Type | Holds a valid record in SECURITY.MASTER , ASSET.TYPE , or SUB.ASSET.TYPE |

**TransactionFees Charges Taxes**

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| External | Indicates that it is an external fee. For example, turnover fee levied by stock exchange or securities transaction tax |
| Bank | Specifies any additional fee or charge levied by the bank on top of brokerage or commission |

**TransactionFees Charges Taxes**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| All In Fee | Indicates whether the customer broker commission is waived or not. If this field is set to Yes, the value in the Cu Brkr Comm field (broker commission on customer side) in SC.EXE.SEC.ORDERS is updated as zero and the bank directly pays the commission to the broker. |
| Product Type | Indicates a valid SECURITY.MASTER ID, where the asset type records are prefixed by A- and sub-asset type records are prefixed by S- or ALL |
| Security Domicile | Indicates a valid country code or ALL. A corresponding record in SECURITY.MASTER is created, if this field is set to US and sub-asset type as 301. This record is used while creating the orders. |
| Index | Indicates the value defaulted from the combined values of the Product Type* Security Domicile fields. This is a display-only field. |

**TransactionFees Charges Taxes**

| Fields | Description |
|---|---|
| Include Source Tax | Indicates whether Source Tax Amt in ENTITLEMENT is to be included in deal amount calculation from ENTITLEMENT . By default, the source tax is not considered for calculating tax. |
| Total Discount/ Premium | Indicates the total discount or premium of a security in a company for exemption of European Union Services Directive (EUSD) tax calculation. The tax exemption is applicable only if the total discount and period discount is calculated using Issue Price and Redem Price of SECURITY.MASTER and does not exceed the values defined in Total Discount/ Premium and Period Discount/ Premium fields. |
| Period Discount/ Premium | Indicates the discount or premium of a security in a company for current period for exemption of EUSD tax calculation |

| Total Settlement (K)[(C)+(J)] |  | 387,838.68 |  | 387,840.88 |

**Transfers**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Ft Pl Chg Cat | Accepts a valid PL Category (50000 to 69999). If a single charge is collected for a bulk transfer and the Charge Account field is not set in SC.BULK.TRANSFER , then the PL Category given in this field is defaulted to Charge Account |
| Fund Trans Status | Accepts the values NAU and AUTH. It specifies the record status to which the FUNDS.TRANSFER record is moved on authorising the SC.BULK.TRANSFER record. If this field value is left blank, the FUNDS.TRANSFER record is changed to IHLD status. The value in this field is defaulted in the Fund Trans Status field of the SC.BULK.TRANSFER application |
| Sec Trans Status | Accepts the values NAU and HOLD. It specifies the record status to which the SECURITY.TRANSFER records is moved on authorising the SC.BULK.TRANSFER record. If this field value is left blank, the SECURITY.TRANSFER record is authorised. The value in this field is defaulted in the Sec Trans Status field of the SC.BULK.TRANSFER application |

**Transfers**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Auto Select | This field is set to Y to display all the security positions relating to the selection criteria and the system makes the required changes (like nominal amount and so on). If this field is left blank, the whole position within the specified criteria is transferred |
| Exchange | This field is set to either Effective or Trade. The options are explained below: Effective - Select this option to use the exchange rate on the trade date of the transfer transaction Trade - Select this option to use the exchange rate on the trade dates of the underlying trade transactions |
| Trans Type Dr Trans Type Cr | The values are defaulted from the Sec Dr Trans Code and Sec Cr Trans Code fields in SC.STD.POS.TRANSF . The values in both the Trans Type Dr and Trans Type Cr fields are used as transaction codes for debiting and crediting STOCK. These fields allow a valid record in SC.TRANS.NAME . The settlement instructions can also be defaulted for both From and To depositories in the Depository From and Depository To field. |

**Transfers**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Stamp Indicator | Defaults from SC.SETT.INSTRUCT based on the broker transaction code. . The user can overwrite this field value. The value must be in AAAA/BBBB or BBBB format and is mapped to 22F tag, stamp duty indicator in sequence E of MT54X (X= 0 to 3). This is a free format field and requires no validation |
| Stamp Price | Defines the user input stamp price which is mapped to 90B tag of TRADDET block in MT54X (X= 0 TO 3) instead of using the existing broker price |
| Sprty Narr Qual | Indicates the qualifier pertaining to narrative in 70A tag of the SETPRTY block in MT540 to MT543 |
| Sprty Narr | Indicates the free format narrative mapped to 70A tag of the SETPRTY block in MT540 to MT543. If the narrative is entered with the qualifier DECL or PACO, it is mapped to 70E or 70C tag, respectively in the SETPRTY block. |
| Bene Owner | Indicates the user-defined beneficial owner. It is mapped to 22F tag qualifier BENE in SETDET block. The value must be entered as per the SWIFT guidelines. |
| Buyr Nation | Indicates the user-defined country code of the buyer. It is mapped to the 95C tag in the qualifier INVE of the OTHRPRTY block |

|---|---|

**Transfers**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Trans Type | Determines the type of transaction. This is a mandatory field and its value is mapped to Transaction Type field in the SECURITY.TRANSFER application |
| Portfolio No | Accepts a valid portfolio in which the movement of securities take place. This is a mandatory field and its value is mapped to Security Acc field in the SECURITY.TRANSFER application |
| Counterparty | Identifies sender or receiver of the transfer. This field accepts a valid customer from the CUSTOMER.SECURITY application. The role of the customer has to be BROKER, COUNTERPARTY or CLIENT. It is mapped to the Broker No field in the SECURITY.TRANSFER application |
| Payment Reqd | Maps to the Payment Reqd field in the SECURITY.TRANSFER application |
| Broker Advice Reqd | Maps to the Broker Advice Reqd field in the SECURITY.TRANSFER application |
| Nominee Code | Maps to the Nominee Code field of the SECURITY.TRANSFER application |
| Cust Remarks | Maps to the Cust Remarks field of the SECURITY.TRANSFER application |
| Sec Trans Status | Accepts the values NAU and HOLD. The value in this field is defaulted from the Sec Trans Status field of the SC.STD.POS.TRANSF application. If this field values is left blank, then the SECURITY.TRANSFER record is authorised When set to INPUT.INAU, the record in SECURITY.TRANSFER is created in INAU status when the record in SC.BULK.TRANSFER is created in INAU. When record in SC.BULK.TRANSFER is authorised, the record in SECURITY.TRANSFER continues to be in INAU The record in SECURITY.TRANSFER must be authorised individually. If bulk authorisation is required, then the Authorize field can be set to Yes in SC.BULK.TRANSFER application . If the Authorize field is enabled, then the system triggers the service to authorise all records in SECURITY.TRANSFER created by the bulk transfer |
| Fund Trans Status | Accepts the values NAU and AUTH. The value in this field is defaulted from the Fund Trans Status field of the SC.STD.POS.TRANSF application. If this field is left blank, the FUNDS.TRANSFER record is changed to hold status |
| Authorize | Set to Yes to trigger the service to authorise the underlying records in SECURITY.TRANSFER . If a particular record in SECURITY.TRANSFER is already authorised, then that particular record is skipped (not authorised) |
| Ssi Code | Defaults with a valid ID of the SC.SETT.INSTRUCT application. This field is mapped to the Ssi Code field in the SECURITY.TRANSFER application |
| Rerun | Accepts the value ENRICH. When set to ENRICH, the value in the Ssi Code field is mapped to SECURITY.TRANSFER application. This can be used to assign a settlement instruction to all the transfers generated out of the bulk transfer. This is useful when a technical broker is used in the transaction and a settlement instruction has to be specified for this particular transaction. A technical broker is used when the counterparty is not on-boarded into the system (as the interaction with the counterparty is one time, banks sometimes prefer not to on-board these counterparties) |
| Transfer Price | Accepts the values Gross or Null. When set to Gross, in the SC.BULK.TRANSFER application, the system populates the average gross price (purchase price) of the acquired nominals in the Price field. This price is mapped to the Price field in the underlying SECURITY.TRANSFER that is created. The Gross Cost Sec Ccy field in SECURITY.POSITION is used to calculate the gross price of the underlying nominals. When set to Null, in the SC.BULK.TRANSFER application, the system populates the market price in the Price field. This field is selected only for Transfer Out scenario, that is, when the Transaction code implies a debit of securities. |

**Transfers**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Transfer Type | Indicates that the transfer is BCT when this field is set to Custodian |
| Depository From | Holds the Custodian Id from whom the position is moved out |
| Sub Account From | Holds the sub-account held with the custodian from whom the position is moved out |
| Sec Account From | Used when position is moved from one portfolio to another portfolio. In such scenario, this holds the portfolio from which the position is moved out. |
| Depository To | Holds the Custodian Id to whom the position is moved to |
| Sub Account To | Holds the sub-account held with the custodian to whom the position is moved to |
| Sec Account To | Used when position is moved from one portfolio to another portfolio. In such cases, this field holds the portfolio id of the Portfolio to which the position is moved to. |
| Bct Security No | Holds the id of the instrument master. This is used when only specific instruments are to be moved. If this field is left blank, all positions held with in the From Custodian field is moved out. This field can be multi-valued to add multiple instruments. |
| Bct Sec Acc Master | Holds the customer security account. Used only when the Bct Security No is input. This field is used to specify the portfolio, which is in scope of this transfer. This is a sub-value field. Multiple portfolios holding the position in Bct Security No can be specified. If this field is left blank, all portfolios holding position in Bct Security No is transferred. |
| Bct Quantity | Holds the quantity associated with Bct Security No and Bct Sec Acc Master . If this field is left blank, the complete holdings of the portfolio on the Bct Security No is transferred out. |

| 7. | HOLIDAY | - Indicates the public holidays for each country, or region within a country for the calendar year. |
| 8. | LANGUAGE | Identifies the languages that are to be used in the system when defining multi-language fields. The Abbreviation code assigned to each Language is used as a screen prompt. |

| 17. | INTERCO.PARAMETER | Determines if automatic balancing entries are raised when processing transactions in a multi-company or a multi-department (in the same company) environment. |
| 18. | EB.DUPLICATE.TYPE | Defines duplicate check criteria for applications. |
| 19. | EB.LOOKUP | This is a generic template to hold all the lookups for data access service. The user can create an EB.LOOKUP record with the definition and use them as drop-down list in applications. |
| 20. | EB.SYSTEM.ID | Provides a description for the SYSTEM.ID field in the accounting entry files, which include STMT.ENTRY , CATEG.ENTRY , CONSOL.NET.TODAY and RE.CONSOL.SPEC.ENTRY . |
| 21. | CONSOLIDATE.COND | The consolidation records hold the consolidation key, series of balance, total debit and credit movement fields. The details are held in for: • Asset and Liability • Profit and Loss |
| 22. | GROUP.ACCRUAL.PARAM | This is a parameter file, which holds the options for the bulk accrual of accounts. It reduces the number of accrual accounting entries by consolidating at various levels. |
| 23. | EB.LOCAL.CONTENT.TABLE | Stores local context-data on customer records at BNK level. |
| 24. | ST.ORGANIZATION.STRUCTURE | Holds the organizational hierarchy of the bank. |
| 25. | ST.ORGANIZATION.CODE | Helps to create Organization Codes at each level defined in the ST.ORGANIZATION.STRUCTURE application. |
| 26. | ST.BRANCH | Holds the branch record, which is updated on authorising the ST.ORGANIZATION.CODE record defined for each branch. |
| 27. | ST.LINE.OF.BUSINESS | Line of Business is defined to create different Cost Centers for the bank and align them later to a particular branch depending on its requirement. |
| 28. | CUSTOMER.EXIT.STATUS | Allows the bank to define the exit statuses and the exit reasons for each customer type (Prospect and Customer). It holds the details such as, allowed customer types, allowed exit reasons. Further, it helps to reclassify a bank Rejected Prospect or Closed (Customer) back to its default or original status. |
| 29. | COMPANY.CREATE | Contains details, such as, Company's Name, Address, Mnemonic, Sub Division code, Creation Date and Default Company details. Allows user to create COMPANY record manually and from which data gets auto-populated in COMPANY application. |
| 30. | ST.CUSTOMER.CLOSURE.PARAM | Customer Exit Status . This parameter application is used to configure the following: Enable Customer Closure - This field can be entered only in the SYSTEM record. The user can select the provided check box to enable the customer closure process and perform the pre-closure checks. Define the pre-closure conditions - The Transact core and non-core applications that must be checked for the presence of the customer data before the customer is closed, can be defined as individual records in this table. The user can define the following attributes in these records where ID of the record will be populated with the application name. Application Access Type - This field is used to define the method through which the customer can be identified in the records of the application specified in the ID. This field will have two options: Field - Denotes that the system must access a particular field of the application to identify the customer ID - The system must use the ID of the record to identify the customer. Application Access Link - The user can provide a field name that will be referred to identify the presence of the customer data. |

**Corporate Actions STP**

| Field Name | Description |
|---|---|
| Swift Caev | Holds a unique value for each DIARY.TYPE record. Any event type mentioned in the swift incoming messages should match with the value in this field of one DIARY.TYPE record. On authorisation of the DIARY.TYPE record, the F.SC.CON.SWIFT.CAEV internal table is updated according to this field value of the DIARY.TYPE record. |
| Diary Create | Indicates the status (HLD, NAU or AUT) of the DIARY records. AUT - If the version used is for authorising, the DIARY is authorised immediately upon creation. This is the default value. NAU - A DIARY record is validated and it is in NAU status until a date is entered in the Dia Auto Auth Date field of the related DIARY record. The COB process automatically authorises it. When it has to be authorised before the date mentioned in Dia Auto Auth Date field, the user can bypass it. HLD – When a DIARY record is created in HLD status, automatic process is not done until the user validates it. |
| Auto ent create | Indicates automatic creation of the ENTILEMENT records. This field is set to Yes, to allow the system to creates an ENTILEMENT for this DIARY record. |
| Tolerance Category, Tolerance Percentage and Tolerance amount | Computes the tolerance limit applicable for the specific diary event. Checks if the value specified in an inward MT566 message is within the tolerance. If yes, then the system automatically updates the DIARY , else the system writes the error message to the SC.CA.ERROR.LOG application. The user has to resolve and commit the DIARY manually. |
| Partial STP | Accepts a valid record from the SC.PARTIAL.STP application. The value ALL denotes that Partial STP flow is followed for the specified records or for ALL records. |
| Pre Dia Days, Pre Dia Pri Aft and Pre Dia Sel Date | Allows auto authorisation of SC.PRE.DIARY . When MT564 is received with PREC or COMP status, the SC.PRE.DIARY record is auto authorised. |

**Corporate Actions STP**

| Field Name | Description |
|---|---|
| Message Type | Stores the message type. That is, 564. |
| From Address | Stores the sender's address. |
| Receiver Address | Stores the receiver’s address. |
| Time Stamp | Stores the time and date when the message was received. It is mapped from DE.I.HEADER record. |
| Link Reference | Stores the Corp Reference ( Corp Ref ). For example, 20C :CORP. |
| Transaction Ref | Stores the SC.PRE.DIARY reference ID (that is, record ID) created upon receiving the incoming MT564. |
| Event Type | Stores the Event Type ( DIARY.TYPE ) in SC.PRE.DIARY . |
| Sender | Stores the T24 customer ID corresponding to the BIC code in From Address . This is usually Depository (in DIARY ) |
| Sender Acc External | Stores the Sub Account Ext ID received in the 97A:SAFE tag. |
| Sender Acc Internal | Stores the sub-account corresponding to the Sub Account Ext ID received in the 97A:SAFE tag. |
| Block Name | Stores the start of the block (in a sequential order from 1) represented by the 16R tag. 16R: GENL is stored as Block Name.1 : GENL.1 If another 16R tag is repeated within a block, it considers the first block name followed by the second, separated by a delimiter (*). 16R: LINK within 16R:GENL is stored as, Block Name.2 : GENL.1*LINK.1. If multiple 16R tags are repeated within a block, it stores them in the sequence they are received, delimited with * and incremented with numbers. If 16R: LINK is received for the second time within 16R:GENL, it is stored as Block Name.3 : GENL1*LINK2 Similarly, it stores the end of block (represented by the16S tag) in sequence, separated by the delimiter (*). |
| Tag Name | Stores the tag name received under each block (like 16R, 16S, 93B). 16R: GENL is stored as Tag Name.1 : 16R. |
| Qualifier | Stores the qualifiers received in each tag. The system considers the values before '//' as Qualifier and maps it in the field and anything after '//' is considered as Tag Value . If '//' is not present, the entire value is treated as Tag Value and Qualifier is not updated. Consider the tag, 93B::ELIG//UNIT/7000. Here, ELIG is Qualifier 93B is Tag Name UNIT/7000 is Tag Value |
| Tag Value | Stores the value received with respect to each tag. The value after '//' is mapped in this field. If '//' is not present, the entire value is treated as Tag Value . For the tag :23G:NEWM, Tag Value is NEWM and there is no Qualifier . In case of :93B::SETT//UNIT/7000, the Tag Value is UNIT/7000. |

**Corporate Actions STP**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Monitor Depo | Indicates the depositories from which the MT564 has not been received, even though position of the security is held. It is a multi-value and no input field |
| Msg Recd Date | Indicates the date when the first MT564 was received |
| Depository | Holds the ID of all the depositories, where the position of the security is held. It is a multi-value field |

**Corporate Actions STP**

| Status Code | Status | Description |
|---|---|---|
| IPRC – Instruction processing status | CAND | Instruction is cancelled |
| DFLA | Default action is taken |  |
| PACK | Instruction is processed |  |
| PEND | Instruction’s processing is pending |  |
| REJT | Instruction is rejected due to system reasons |  |
| STIN | Standing instruction is applied |  |
| EPRC – CA event processing status | COMP | Processing is completed |
| PEND | Processing is not completed |  |
| RECD | Indicates funds paid is reconciled with funds received |  |
| CPRC – Cancellation processing status | CAND | Cancellation request is completed |
| CANP | Cancellation request is pending |  |
| PACK | Cancellation request is accepted for further processing |  |
| REJT | Cancellation request is rejected |  |

**Corporate Actions Workflow**

| Fields | Values |
|---|---|
| Auto Rerun | DAILY |
| Auto Days | 2 |
| Prior After | PRIOR |
| Upto Date | PAY.DATE |

**CustomerInitiatedCorporateActions**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Options Flag | Indicates whether the security is exercisable into ordinary shares. This field is enabled in the option security’s SECURITY MASTER . |
| Conv Exer Sec No | Denotes the number of the new security issued through the conversion or exercise |
| Conv Exer Price | Denotes the price of the new security. For bond conversion, based on the price, the conversion ratios can be input manually by the user |
| Ca Start Date | Denotes the start date for initiating the corporate action (bond conversion or option exercise) |
| Ca End Date | Denotes the end date for initiating the corporate action (bond conversion or option exercise) |
| Old Sec Ratio | Works in conjunction with the New Sec Ratio field. This field denotes the quantity of bond or options for which the new shares are issued. This is defaulted into the Old Ratio field in the DIARY at the time of event creation |
| New Sec Ratio | Works in conjunction with the Old Sec Ratio and Conv Exer Price fields indicating the quantity of a new security issued for holdings in the event security. This is defaulted into the New Ratio field in the DIARY at the time of event creation |
| Rounding | Captures the rounding methods to handle ratios, which lead to fractional shares. The accepted values are Standard, Up and Down. |

**CustomerInitiatedCorporateActions**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Conv Exer Sec No | 802000-100 |
| Conv Exer Price | 6.67 |
| Ca Start Date | MAY 19, 2010 |
| Ca End Date | JUN 10, 2015 |
| Old Sec Ratio | 100 |

**CustomerInitiatedCorporateActions**

| Underlying Security Transfer Fields | Values |
|---|---|
| Transaction Type | Credit transaction code of the transaction type defined in SC.PARAMETER |
| Security No | Target Security from the primary security transfer |
| Customer No | Defaulted from the primary security transfer |
| Security Acc | Defaulted from the primary security transfer |
| No Nominal | The nominal is calculated based on the ratio defined for this conversion in the SC.ADR.GDR.DETS application. If the quantity of incoming security calculated using the ration is in decimals, then it must be rounded down. |
| Trade Date | Defaulted from primary security transfer |
| Value Date | Defaulted from primary security transfer |
| Broker No | Defaulted from primary security transfer |
| Delivery Instr | *See Steps below |
| Conversion Fee | *See steps below |
| Cost | COST of the parent transfer (SECURITY.TRANSFER OUT) |

**Dividend with Choice**

|---|---|---|---|
| Ratio | 92K | ADEX//UKWN or NEWO//UKWN | Old Ratio and New Ratio in NEW.SEC.NO multi-value set |
| Date | 98B | PAYD//UKWN or PAYD//ONGO | Opt Pay Date in OPTION.DESC multi-value |

**Dividend with Choice**

| CA attribute | MT566 Tag | Sample Values | DIARY field |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ratio | 92D under the SECMOVE block of CACONF for the SECU option | 92D::NEWO//1,/123,5532 or 92D::ADEX//1,/123,5532 | The Old Ratio and New Ratio fields in NEW.SEC.NO multi-value set For the given sample value, the update is, OLD.RATIO = 123.5532 NEW.RATIO = 1 |
| Date | 98B of SECMOVE block of CACONF for the SECU option | 98A::PAYD// 98A::POST// 98A::EARL// | Opt Pay Date in OPTION.DESC multi-value set. When the 566 is received with the PAYD, POST or EARL qualifiers, the Opt Pay Date field is updated in the below order. EARL – Earliest Pay Date PAYD – Pay Date POST – Posting Date |

**Dividend with Choice**

| Field | SC.PRE.DIARY or DIARY Field | MT564 Tag | Value of MT564 tag in outward message |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ratio | OLD.RATIO and NEW.RATIO in NEW.SEC.NO multi-value set | 92K | ADEX//UKWN |

**DRIPs DelayedReceiptOfPrice**

| Field Name | Description |
|---|---|
| Drips | The dividend re-investments are enabled when this field is set as ‘Yes’. Cash proceeds of the stock option are parked in the suspense account until the price of the new stock is declared. |
| Cust Or Bank | If the Cash Remain field is set as Yes, then a value must be entered in the Cust Or Bank field. The options available are either Customer (default value) or Bank. It controls whether the remaining cash, if any, is to be credited to the customer or the bank. |
| Pl Category | When Cust Or Bank field is set as ‘Customer’, the Pl Category field is a no input field. However, if Cust Or Bank field is set to ‘Bank’, then the Pl Category field becomes mandatory and accepts any valid Pl Category already setup in Temenos Transact. |

**DRIPs DelayedReceiptOfPrice**

| Field Name | Description |
|---|---|
| Drips | When this field is set to ‘Cash. Reinvest’, the cash proceeds of both CASH and SECU options are credited to the Customer Account on the pay date of the CASH option. |

**DRIPs DelayedReceiptOfPrice**

| CA attribute | MT566 Tag | Sample Values | DIARY field |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ratio | 92D under the SECMOVE block of CACONF for the SECU option | 92D::ADEX//1,/123,5532 or 92D::NEWO//1,/123,5532 | OLD.RATIO and NEW.RATIO in NEW.SEC.NO multi-value set of the SECU option. For the sample value, the update would be, OLD.RATIO = 123.5532 NEW.RATIO = 1 |
| Price | 90B of CASHMOVE block of CACONF for the SECU option | 90B:PRPP//ACTU/USD25,3987 | NEW.PRICE of NEW.SEC.NO of the SECU option. |

**Equalisation**

| Fields | Description |
|---|---|
| Rate | Records the G1 dividend rate |
| Group Rate | The G2 rate representing the income |
| Equalise Rate | The equalisation rate representing the capital portion |
| Equalisation Date | The previous ex-dividend date |

**Equalisation**

| Fields | Description |
|---|---|
| Qualifying Holdings | Records the position held as on the previous dividend date, therefore qualifying for the normal G1 dividend, which is reported in the Entitlement Amount field |
| Equalise Hlding | Displays the total purchases since the previous date, on which the G2 and equalisation dividends are to be paid |
| Group2 Amt | Displays the amount of G2 income dividend |
| Equalise Amt | Displays the amount of equalisation dividend (capital) to be received |

**Handling Linked Events**

| Fields | Description |
|---|---|
| Link Diary Id | Indicates the DIARY ID of the parent event |
| Link Condition App 1 | Indicates the application based on which entitlements need to be generated for the linked event (Allowed values are CUSTOMER/ENTITLEMENT/SEC.ACC.MASTER) |

**Incremental Customer Election**

**Incremental Customer Election**

| Field Name | Description |
|---|---|
| Multi Election | Elects a portion of the eligible holdings at a time and uses the value in the Pending Nominal field to store the unelected quantity. The possible values of this field are Yes, No and Null. This field is set to Yes in this scenario. |
| Skip Multi Ele Delivery | Allows to skip MT565 generation from each ENTITLEMENT . The possible values of this field are Yes, No and Null. This field is set to Yes in this scenario. The system sends a consolidated omnibus MT565 per option for the elected quantity from DIARY, if an MT565 is triggered through MT565.INSTRUCT or when all the entitlements are elected. |
| Multi Ele Ent Conf | Configures whether a single MT566 or multiple MT566s will be received from the custodian for the event type. This field is set to Single in this scenario where the possible values of this field are Single, Multi and Null. The system reconciles the custodian confirmed quantity or cash against the system quantity or cash and automatically authorise the entitlements that are reconciled on the pay date when MT566 is received. If the reconciliation between the system and custodian quantity or cash fails, then the system updates the SC.CA.ERROR.LOG application with the error log for the mismatch |

Each MT566 refers the MT565 through the 20C://RELA tag. This tag contains the SEME reference of MT565. **Incremental Customer Election**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Skip Multi Ele Delivery | Possible values- Yes/ No/ Null. This field is set as, Yes for CHOS events No for long VOLU events like Takeover Yes for short VOLU events like say optional conversion. |
| Multi Ele Ent Conf | Holds the setup whether a single MT566 or multiple MT566s are received from the custodian for the event type. The possible values for the field are Single, Multi and Null. If this field is set to Single and the reconciliation between the custodian quantity or cash and system quantity or cash is successful, all the entitlements that belongs to that omnibus are authorised. If reconciliation fails, SC.CA.ERROR.LOG or SC.ENT.MULTI.ELECTION is updated with the error log of the mismatch. When the system sends a single MT565 from DIARY or multiple MT565s from ENTITLEMENT, reconciliation against a single MT566 per option on the cut-off date is possible. |

**Rounding, Odd Lot and Fraction Handling**

| Type | Description |
|---|---|
| Down | Always rounds down the value. This is the equivalent to the Round Down Only field being set as YES. |
| Standard | Follows the standard rounding rules. This is the equivalent to the Round Down Only field being set as NO. |
| Up | Rounds up the value. |
| Fraction | Takes the fractional amount of the trading unit. |

**Sale or Notice of Retension**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Qual Hold CRI | Defines the holding check criteria. If set to AMT, the entitlement generation criteria is based on the shareholder value in the event security If set to NOM, the entitlement generation criteria is based on the shareholder’s quantity in the event security |
| Qual Hold Val | Represents the shareholder value or quantity of shareholdings in the event security below which the entitlements are generated for the shareholder |
| Qual Hold Pri | Holds the price of the event security. This price is the closing price on the record rate. The price input in the field calculates the shareholder’s value in the event security when the Qual Hold CRI is set to AMT. |
| Mktble Holding | Indicates the marketable quantity. It is a system computed field and it is calculated as Qual Hold Val or Qual Hold Pri (is calculated only when Qual Hold CRI is set to AMT). The field is updated based on trading units of the SECURITY.MASTER . |

**Sale or Notice of Retension**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Sale Price | This is mapped to the Rate field under the Sell option in DIARY . Using the Rate and Final Debit Qty , the system calculates the expected cash receivable for shareholder ( Entitlement Amt ) in the entitlements for all the customers who have elected to sell. |
| Top up Price | This is mapped to the New Price field under the top-up option. This in turn triggers the calculation of Nominal in the entitlements for all the customers who have elected to top-up. |

**Stamp Tax on Corporate Actions**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Stamp Calc Rtn | This field indicates the name of the routine that calculates the amount subject to the tax and updates it on the ENTITLEMENT application. Validation is not made against the routine name entered in this field. |
| Stamp Min Amt | This field contains the amount in charge of the bank. Only the stamp tax amounts which are greater than this amount are charged to the customer. |
| Stamp Cat Bk | This field indicates the category to which the stamp tax (in charge of the bank) is posted. |

**Takeover**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|

| Rate Amount | Holds the calculated amount for each qualifier (OFFR/SOFE/ESOF). The user can further amend the value, if required. |
| Ent Amt Settle Ccy | Holds the total value of rate amount for each qualifier applicable. |

**Misc**

| Services | Description |
|---|---|
| DE.EOP.INWARD and DE.EOP.OUTWARD | These services analyse the DE.O.HEADER and DE.I.HEADER entries respectively to identify the records that are processed completely. These services select the DE.I.HEADER and DE.O.HEADER records, moving the records from DE.I.HEADER to DE.I.HEADER.ARCH and DE.O.HEADER to DE.O.HEADER.ARCH respectively. |
| DE.MM.CLEAR.HANDOFF | This service deletes the DE.O.HANDOFF records where DE.O.HEADER is previously removed. This service selects all the DE.O.HANDOFF records to identify the records to be deleted. |

**Misc**

| S.No | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | Tracker Status Reason | Allows users to define the status code and status reason which is used to update the status of the incoming MT103 payment in the SWIFT Confirmation tracker. |
| 2. | DE.MESSAGE.HEADER | Allows users to define the message headers, which are used for various type of messages. For each header, it stores the version, set of Business and Generic Metadata, which must be pushed as part of the data event with the payload. |
| 3. | DE.BUSINESS.SERVICE.RULES | Allows users to create business service rules for delivery messages based on domain, message name id, business application, application context field, application context value, start date, end date, business service and status. When a Delivery Message is handed off to Delivery, it considers the supplied value if the Business Application supplies the Business Service. Otherwise, it determines the Business Service based on the DE.BUSINESS.SERVICE.RULES application setup. |
| 4. | DE.DELIVERY.RESPONSES | Stores the incoming replies received for the outward interact MX messages (Ack/Nack/DLN) sent through delivery. It is possible to store other replies sent by other bank systems, which are acting as an intermediary systems before the messages sent to SWIFT network. |
| 5. | DE.DLN.REQUIREMENTS | Allows the bank to define the rules to request a positive or overdue delivery notification. In this way, the bank has the option to request a positive delivery notification and overdue warning (Optional). It is not possible to request only overdue warning. |
| 6. | DE.ALT.CHARS | This table helps to parameterise the alternate characters (defined in ASCII.VAL.TABLE ) for the local unsupported characters. Various rules are defined to replace the alt chars based on the position of the unsupported character in the message string. A default alternate character is defined if alternate character is not defined for an unsupported character. |
| 7. | DE.MSG.CHARS.RULE | This parameter table defines the character set rules for each carrier and message type. |

**Capital Gain on Transfers**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Trfr Eff Date | Records the original date of acquisition of the security being transferred in. It defaults to the trade date of the transaction, if not specified. |
| Cg Tax Eff Date | Records the tax effective date of the transfer. It defaults to the trade date of the transaction, if not specified. |
| Price or Cost | Records the price or cost at which the lot was acquired. Input of one calculates the other. This is the price that is updated in CG.TXN.BASE as the cost of the parcel. |

**Capital Gains on Corporate Actions**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Cg Enh Process | Set to Yes for the working of all enhanced CG calculations. |
| Ca Odd Lot | Indicates how to adjust any odd nominal while apportioning nominal among the existing tax lots due to a CA. |
| Period Inc Td | Indicates whether trade date is included while determining the period of holding. If the field is set to: Yes - The trade date is included while determining the period of holding. No - It indicates that the period of holding starts from T+1 days. |

**Capital Gains on Corporate Actions**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Income Event | If this field is flagged, then there is no update in the Cg Txn Base field. Instead, the system opens a record with entitlement ID in the ENTITLEMENT.INC.SUPP table and records the total income received from this event. This field can be set even for events such as, stock dividend where dividend is received in the form of stock. This helps to report income earned from CAs. |
| Upd Cost | If this field is flagged, then the cost of the tax parcel or lots changes because of the CA event. |
| Upd Lot Es | If shares are received or disposed as a result of CA and if this field is flagged, then the nominal or quantity of the existing tax lot is amended. |
| Es Lot Date | If nominal of existing lot is changed, then the acquisition date of the new nominal is based on the value of this field. |
| Upd Lot Ns | If new shares are received in a new security from the CA event, then this field needs to be flagged. For example, demerger event. |
| Calc Cg | This flag has to be set if CG needs to be calculated. This is critical for events where lots are disposed. |

**Capital Gains on Corporate Actions**

| Events | Description |
|---|---|
| Creation of new tax lots | When new positions are acquired from CA events, new tax lot IDs are created. The details such as event type, associated trades, date of acquisition, quantity, price, cost and others are recorded in the tax lots. |
| Adjustment of positions and cost in existing tax lots | The nominal and cost base are adjusted in the tax lots to reflect the exact nominal and cost after the CA events. Capital gain or loss may be calculated in certain scenarios. |
| Closing of tax lots | When a CA event moves out all the positions held in a tax lot, the tax lot is closed and capital gain or loss may be calculated. |
| Closing of existing lots and creating new lots | There are some CA events that require the existing lots to be closed and new lots be created. |
| Adjustment of tax lots | Adjusting cost in existing lots and creating new lots. |
| No change to tax lots | Pure income only events like cash dividends have no effect on tax lots. |

**Capital Gains on Corporate Actions**

| Condition | Value in Income Type field in SC.ENT.INCOME.SUPP application | Value in Income Amt field in SC.ENT.INCOME.SUPP application | Calculation of Cost of New Parcel |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rights Event - When retail premium is declared as income | Retail Premium | Lapsed Rights * Retail Premium Rate | - |
| Capital Return | Capital Return | Qualify Holding * (Rate - Income on Rate) | - |
| Capital Return | Income | Qualify Holding * Income on Rate | - |
| Buy Back | Income | Buy Back Quantity * Income on Buy back price | - |
| Demerger –If dividend is applicable | Demerger Dividend | Nominal of New Security * Income Rate | - |
| Other Events – If Income Event is set in CG.CA.RULES | Income | Qualify Holding * Rate | - |
| Other Events – If Income Event is set in Cg.Ca.Rules | Stock Income (with rate) | Nominal of New Security * New Market price The New Mkt Price in DIARY defaults from Last Price in SECURITY.MASTER and should be changed, if required. | Nominal * New Market Price + Entitlement Amount (Residue stock remaining from Reinvest where Cash Remain in DIARY.TYPE is set to Y) |
| Other Events - If Income Event is set in CG.CA.RULES | Stock Income (with old to new ratio) | Nominal * New Market price The New Mkt Price in DIARY defaults to the Last Price in SECURITY.MASTER . If required, this should be changed to the New Price in DIARY that is, price used for Dividend Reinvestment nominal. | Nominal * New Market price The New Mkt Price in DIARY defaults to the Last Price in SECURITY.MASTER . If required, this should be changed to the New Price in DIARY that is, price used for Dividend Reinvestment nominal. |

**Franking Credits**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Franked Credit Rate | Holds the rate or percentage that is used for computing franking credits. |
| Unfranked Rate | Holds the rate or percentage of the unfranked rate. If value is not provided, the value is defaulted as Rate (dividend rate) minus Franked Credit Rate. |
| Unfranked Cfi Rate | Holds conduit foreign income rate and should not exceed the value in Unfranked Rate field. Conduit foreign income is foreign income ultimately received by a foreign resident through one or more interposed Australian corporate tax entities (including companies and some trusts). When paid as an unfranked dividend, the payment is subject to non-resident withholding tax. |

**Franking Credits**

| Field Name | Purpose | Formula | Values as per the screenshot |
|---|---|---|---|
| Franked Dividend | Holds the franking dividend amount for the entitlement. | Franked Credit Rate * Qual Holding | = 3* 1400 = USD 4200 |
| Franking Credits | Hold sthe Franking credits for this entitlement in Event Currency. | Franked Dividend * Corporate Tax Rate / (1- Corporate Tax Rate ) | = 4200 *30% /(1-30%) =USD 1800 |
| Unfranked Cfi | Holds the Unfranked CFI for this entitlement. | Unfranked Cfi Rate * Qual Holdings | =3*1400 = USD 4200 |
| Unfranked Ncfi Rate | Holds the Unfranked Non-Conduit Foreign Income (NCFI) rate. | Unfranked Rate – Unfranked Cfi Rate | = 7 - 3 = USD 4 |
| Unfranked Ncfi | Holds the Unfranked NCFI for the entitlement. | Unfranked Ncfi Rate * Qual Holdings | = 4 *1400 = USD 5600 |
| Net Dividend | Holds the entitlement amount. | Rate * Qual Holdings | = 10*1400 = USD 14000 |
| Gross Dividend | Indicates a dividend inclusive of franking credits. | Net Dividend + Franking Credits | =14000+1800 =USD 15800 |

**Manual Adjustment of Tax Lots**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Apply to all | If set to Yes, the system pro rates the Total Units to Adj or the Total Amt to Adjust among the retrieved lots. The system then automatically pro-rates and updates the value in Adj Red Cost and Adj Trd Cost fields in case of adjustment in cost and Adj Nominal in case of adjustment in nominal |
| Retrieve Lots | If set to Open, the system retrieve only the open credit tax lots as of current date for adjustment. If it is set to Open on Eff Dt, the system retrieves and displays all lots that were open as on the Tax Effective Date in the transaction |
| Create New Lot | If this field is set and the units are increased, the system: Creates the new units as a separate new lot with the acquisition date being the acquisition date of the old parcel Updates the tax effective date of the new parcel being the tax effective date specified in the CG.ADJUST.BASE transaction |

**Manual Adjustment of Tax Lots**

| Rollover | Description |
|---|---|
| Full | The system creates as many open lots in the CG.TXN.BASE of acquired security, as the open lots in the current security, with same acquisition date and cost as in the current security. |
| Blank | The system rolls over the parcels that the user has specified to rollover, along with mentioned cost. |

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Net Long Term Loss and Net Short Term Loss | Indicate if the long- or short-term loss can be offset only against long- or short-term gain or both |
| Lt Loss Cf Years and St Loss Cf Years | Indicate the number of years that the long- and short-term loss can be carried forward |
| Max Amt Cf Lt and Max Amt Cf St | Specifies the maximum amount of long- and short-term losses carried forward per year |
| Annual Adj Amt Lt and Annual Adj Amt St | Specify the maximum carried forward long- and short-term losses that can be set-off against gains per year. |

| Short Term Rate and Long Term Rate | Specify the rate applicable for holding. |
| CA Odd Lot | Specifies whether the odd nominal are to be adjusted in the first or last lot. |
| CG Calc Param | Holds the relevant data for a particular country’s CG calculation. |
| Sep External Lots | This field is set to Yes to maintain separate tax records for external custody positions. If this field is left blank, then both the external and on-platform positions are updated in the same CG.TXN.BASE . |
| Franking Cr Allowed | This field is set to Yes only in countries where franking credits are allowed. |
| Retain Specific Lot | Ensures that any specifically selected lot remains untouched while reworking. It remains as originally allocated and only the other lots are reworked. |
| Recalc Lock Date | Reallocates and calculates capital gains or losses up to the mentioned date. |

**Misc**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| CG Method | Defines the tax lot method applicable for each set. Only the methods allowed in the CG.PARAMETER can be set here. |
| Date to | Denotes the date till when the values defined in the corresponding multi-value set are applicable. These dates must be given in descending order, that is the oldest date in the last multi-value set. The first date must be left blank. |
| Long Term Period | The tax lot held less than the period defined in this field is treated as a short-term holdings. If left blank, then the value is defaulted from the CG.PARAMETER . |
| Long Term Rate and Short Term Rate | The tax rate applicable for short and long term holdings are defined in these fields. |
| Discount Factor | Denotes the discount factor (in percentage) used to calculate discounted PL. |
| Adjustment Factor | Calculates the tax liability under TAFO method. |

**Misc**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Cg Method 1 | Indicates the particular capital gains method applicable upto the date defined in the Date To field |
| Date To 1 | Used to set up the end dates for each of Cg Method . Dates need to be defined in descending order, that is, oldest date in the lowest sub-value. The Latest Date To 1 field cannot be populated with any value as it relates to the current period |
| Reacq Prd | Indicates the period of time elapsed between a sale and subsequent purchase, so that the purchase is not regarded as a repurchase of that sale |
| Reacq Drop Loss | Specifies whether this is a requirement to drop any loss associated with a sale |
| Cg Incl Accr Int | Indicates whether accrued interest is included in the calculation of the CG profit and loss or not |
| Cg Incl Expense | Indicates whether expenses are included in the calculation of the CG and loss or not |
| Wcg Incl Accr Int | Indicates whether accrued interest is included in the calculation of the CG withheld tax profit and loss |
| Wcg Incl Expense | Indicates whether expenses are included in the calculation of the CG withheld tax profit and loss |
| Wht Tax Type | Indicates the record from TAX.TYPE which is used for CG tax calculation |

| CG Methods Allowed 1 | Indicates the list of methods allowed for tax lot allocation and CG calculations. The methods listed in this field can alone be used in setting up the portfolio-specific allocation |
| Long Term Period | Holds a time period that determines whether asset needs to be considered as long or short term. Any holding for less than this period is treated as a short-term holding |
